steps.name: links_absolute_from_origin
steps.script: var vals=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td.val')).map(function(t){return t.textContent.trim();});var origin=window.location.origin;var urls=vals.filter(function(v){return v.indexOf('http')===0;});var fromOrigin=urls.filter(function(v){return v.indexOf(origin)===0;});var drive=vals.filter(function(v){return /^[A-Za-z]:[\/]/.test(v)||v.indexOf('file://')===0;});return JSON.stringify({origin:origin,cellCount:vals.length,urlCount:urls.length,urlsBuiltFromOrigin:fromOrigin.length,drivePathCells:drive.length,firstUrl:urls[0]||null});
steps.label: URLs are td.val text, not anchors: every one must start with the live origin
